text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
—— Luckily it's just a minor injury,
so your day-to-day life won't be affected.
But taking on the lead role in the play
is 
a different story……

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
There's a lot of physical activity involved,
is there not? 
It will put too much strain on your legs.
Considering your future in racing,
I'd advise you not to take chances.

text_block_list.name: Votive Play Instructor
text_block_list.text:
—— Given the circumstances,
I'm afraid Ms. King Halo 
will need to step down from the Shirabyōshi
role…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But… that can't be… Madam King put 
her heart and soul into that role…!

text_block_list.name: Votive Play Instructor
text_block_list.text:
I know it's frustrating,
but she shouldn't push herself 
and make her injury worse.
I'm sorry… I haven't been 
attentive enough as you supervisor either.

text_block_list.name: Votive Play Instructor
text_block_list.text:
…… That being said,
we'll find a substitute for the
Shirabyōshi 
role. However, given the limited time,
it'll be tough to perform 
the "traditional" version with a changed
cast.

text_block_list.name: Votive Play Instructor
text_block_list.text:
So, this year we'll have to go with the
abridged version. 
Since that cuts out a few scenes,
there should still be 
enough time to fit practice for the lead
role in.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The abridged version…… Well,
I guess we have no choice…

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Now the issue is, who's going to 
step into the Shirabyōshi role…?

text_block_list.name: Votive Play Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Regarding that matter… I've thought it
through on my end, 
taking into consideration various factors
and circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Votive Play Instructor
text_block_list.text:
—— Ms. Kawakami Princess,
could you please take the role?

text_block_list.name: Votive Play Instructor
text_block_list.text:
This abridged script features the
Shirabyōshi, 
the Shirabyōshi's mentor,
the twin butterflies, 
and a solo traveling performer.

text_block_list.name: Votive Play Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Ms. King will play the mentor to lessen her
physical strain. 
The role of the traveling performer will be
handled by 
Ms. Haru Urara alone. …Is that manageable?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm on it! I'll do my absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Votive Play Instructor
text_block_list.text:
—— Now that's settled,
let's proceed with the reassigned roles.

text_block_list.name: Votive Play Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Ms. King Halo,
please focus on recovering.
Feel free to offer 
guidance to the others if you notice anything
amiss.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
…… I'm sorry for the trouble.
I'll assist with 
the Shirabyōshi training as well.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: O mighty and revered three pillars, witness my dance till its end.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Your elbows are dropping.
Keep your focus from shoulders to elbows,
all the way to your fingertips.
And don't neglect your 
footwork either.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Draw near, draw near, heed the resolve I have ——

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Woah!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, she's flustered, she's flustered! Not quite sharp on the left, more focus she needs!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ugh, you pesky butterflies! Just you wait and see… um…

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Just you watch. Right, left, forward, and back. I shall give you a performance thorough and captivating!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Rehearse your lines while practicing the
movements. 
I know it's tough with the time left… but
every bit helps. —— Alright,
let's start from the top again!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes ma'am…!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Now then, a dance I shall present you. Here goes! —— Woah, uw～～eeeii!?

text_block_list.name: Votive Play Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Keep a firm grip!
Stay aware of your core. 
Let's try that once more!

text_block_list.name: Votive Play Instructor
text_block_list.text:
That's enough for today.
We'll have more rehearsals 
tomorrow,
but let's not push ourselves too hard.

text_block_list.name: All Together
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ……… Pathetic.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm so…… pathetic……

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: —— Found ya, King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—— ! 
…… Oh dear, do you need something?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's eat some ice cream! 
Sweet things always give you a boost of
energy!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
……… Sorry for causing you concern. 
…… But I understand. If I'm injured,
I just have to accept it.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
But it's still frustrating for you,
isn't it? King, you have 
the same look on your face as when you lose
a race.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I know you've been working really hard!
And how much you 
cherished playing the Shirabyōshi,
just like racing!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: —— But that means everything will be okay!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh…?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Because you always come back stronger 
the next day, no matter how upset you are!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: …… You're right.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
…… Hehe, you're absolutely right. 
Thanks, this ice cream tastes great.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome!! Let me have a bite! 
I'll share some of mine with you too!
